mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with high housing starts and low unemployment, the S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and policy pivot risks, generating negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1300 and UNRATE < 4.0), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has risen over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 1300 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime defined by high nonfarm payrolls and low unemployment, robust consumer spending drives corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as strong labor market (PAYEMS > 159000 and UNRATE < 4.0), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI and stable/falling federal funds rate signals persistent inflation without sufficient monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to real rate uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
